bridgeConstraints: Agent Bridge is an external development/control plane only; never a runtime, build, production, agent, orchestration, evaluation or Enterprise Local dependency of WonderPages; WonderPages works unchanged if the Bridge is removed
The Bridge does not change the application's functional architecture nor the identity, permanence, orchestration or contracts of the 11 agents
Subscription-first: no OpenAI API, Anthropic API or other pay-per-token/pay-per-call service as a mandatory dependency without a later explicit operator decision
